name: The Goat's Stand
summary: The village goat has taken a position on the notice board and refuses to leave it, and a notice has gone up that says the board is the evacuation point.

stages.journal: The goat is on the notice board, and the board is the evacuation point.
stages.hint: Get the goat off the board, or the board away from the goat.

stages.journal: The goat is off the board. It has not forgiven anyone.
We left the goat on the board. It will meet whatever comes with the same expression.
